title: console: changing or clearing the owner in a record's Edit form is silently dropped — the PATCH omits owner_id entirely (inline edit of the same field works)
body:
Filing gate ①: a product defect, reproduced and measured. Source: 2026-10-12 hosted-shape browser pass of HotCRM 4.0.1 on a cloud rig at production v1.36.0's pins (objectui `d758f2f20d`, framework `56bf27affb`).
Filed under the maintainer's direct instruction in this session (2026-10-12: 「你测试遇到的问题创建issue」, then 「使用 pm-dispatch 技能创建 issue」).
Reader: objectui triage (routing), then the `domain:ui` lane's execution seat (`plugin-form`).
Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectui is:issue owner_id form` → 19 hits, all states. `… owner edit form save` → 120. Nearest: #10108 (closed: a master-detail save sent owner_id and got 403) and #12103 (closed, PR #12117). PR #12117's own notes predicted exactly this defect and filed no card for it: 「Edit forms strip `owner_id` from every payload by name (`SERVER_OWNED_FIELD_NAMES` in `plugin-form`'s `sanitize.ts`) … gets an enabled input whose change Save drops. This was not changed and not measured here … Carrier: none.」 This card is that measurement.

## What happens

Changing or clearing **负责人 (owner)** in a record's **编辑 (Edit)** form is silently ignored. The form closes as if it saved, but the owner is unchanged, and nothing tells the user that the reassignment did not happen.

Measured:
- **Edit form.** The `PATCH /api/v1/data/<object>/<id>` it sends carries every other form field and **never `owner_id`**. A follow-up GET still shows the old owner.
  - crm_case ×2 (clear, and reassign to another user) and crm_task ×1, by the tester.
  - Re-measured independently on a fresh `crm_task`: the PATCH keys were `description, due_date, is_recurring, priority, progress_percent, recurrence_*, related_to_*, reminder_*, status, subject, type`, with **no `owner_id`**. The owner afterwards was unchanged.
- **Inline edit.** The same field edited inline in the record highlights works: `PATCH {"owner_id": null}` → stored. So the server accepts the write and the caller may make it.

## Suspected origin (not verified)

#10108 (closed) fixed a master-detail batch save that sent `owner_id` on every operation and got 403 "'owner_id' is system-…". It looks as if the remedy now strips `owner_id` from every form submit, including a simple edit form where the user deliberately changed it. Please check `sanitizeFormData` and the form submit path.

## Acceptance

1. An owner the user changes or clears in the Edit form is sent and saved (subject to the server's own permission answer, which must surface as an error if it refuses).
2. An owner the user did not touch is not sent, so the #10108 regression stays fixed.
3. Pin both cases with a test.
